artists.biography: The Abstract Orchestra is an allstar Hip-hop Big Band made of the finest musicians in the U.K that have recorded and toured with the top acts in the world. A live music celebration of some of the most celebrated and influential Hip-hop artists and their music. perplexity.description:
Abstract Orchestra’s debut album Dilla, released in 2017 on ATA Records, is a bold reimagining of the music of legendary Detroit producer J Dilla. The album blends hip hop and jazz, translating Dilla’s iconic beats into lush, live arrangements featuring brass, woodwinds, and dynamic rhythm sections. Tracks such as “Workinonit” and “Stop” showcase the band’s ability to reinterpret Dilla’s sample-based production with biting trumpets, aggressive saxophones, and tight drumming, while maintaining the soulful essence of the originals. The album’s centerpiece includes two medleys that weave together multiple Dilla tracks, highlighting the group’s compositional skill and deep respect for their source material.

Dilla stands as the foundational release in Abstract Orchestra’s discography, establishing their signature approach of transforming hip hop classics into vibrant, orchestral jazz experiences. The album received praise for its inventive arrangements and energetic performances, with critics noting its successful fusion of genres and its homage to Dilla’s legacy. Its release was followed by a UK tour and performances at major festivals, further cementing Abstract Orchestra’s reputation as innovators in the jazz-hip hop crossover space.
